title: Multiple integral representations of the Catalan's constant
summary: In this paper, we present several novel integral representations of Catalan's constant. We begin by deriving an initial result expressed as a double integral. Subsequently, as a consequence of this result, we establish a general theorem that enables the representation of Catalan's constant in terms of a single integral. Finally, we provide a multiple integral representation of Catalan's constant in dimensions greater than or equal to two using the Lerch function. The results are accompanied by illustrative examples.
